essence: The all-knowing giver of the four goals is worthy of repeated reverence.
The great qualityless reality meditated upon by yogins deserves repeated obeisance.
The conqueror of desire and death is worthy of obeisance.
The deity bearing the river in matted hair is honored with repeated obeisance.
The full, auspiciously named destroyer of cities merits repeated obeisance.
